image_description: A busy outdoor market scene featuring a vendor in a light blue shirt arranging produce on a table covered with a blue tarp. In the foreground, there is a large pile of dark green cucumbers. To the right, there are heads of cabbage. Several customers are visible, including a woman in purple on the left and a man in sunglasses on the right. Colorful striped umbrellas provide shade overhead.
